subject: Inquiry: Hosted API rates & eligibility for education-startup co-op
messages:
From: Lara Nguyen <lara.nguyen@teachforward.org>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Hosted API pricing for TeachForward + startup co-op eligibility

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this — I lead engineering at TeachForward, a nonprofit that provides accelerated learning resources to under-resourced school districts. We're planning to launch a student startup co-op this spring where student teams will build apps that use LLMs.

A couple of asks:
- Can you share the hosted API baseline rate card for generation and embeddings?
- Do you have any education or nonprofit pricing (discounts/credits) we can apply across our account and the student startups?
- Is there a formal verification process (501c3, proof of program) and an estimate for how long exceptions take?

For context: our org budget is tight — annual tech spend under $25k, but the co-op expects bursty usage in early months (~3-5M tokens/mo) and then roughly 1M tokens/mo steady. We're happy to consider a short-term committed volume or a pilot credit program. I've attached our 501c3 certificate and a grant award letter that shows program scope.

Attachments: 501c3_certificate.pdf (attached), grant_award_letter.pdf (attached)

Best,
Lara Nguyen
Director of Engineering, TeachForward
lara.nguyen@teachforward.org
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
TeachForward is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit.

Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for TeachForward + startup co-op eligibility

Hi Lara — great to meet you and thanks for the context. Congratulations on the co-op launch — sounds like a meaningful program.

Short answers:
- I can share our baseline hosted API list rates and the typical education/nonprofit discounts we offer.
- We do have a formal verification process (proof of nonprofit status + program description).
- We can also consider a time-limited rate exception or pilot credits for the student startups; we'll need expected token volumes and a short mutual action plan.

Could you confirm:
1) Expected peak tokens in the first 3 months (you mentioned 3-5M/mo — is peak per month or per cohort?)
2) Will the student apps run under TeachForward accounts, or will they register separate accounts? If the latter, we usually require each startup to be linked to the verified nonprofit for discount eligibility.
3) Any procurement/legal required PO or contract language up front?

I'll loop in Marcus (solutions engineer) for technical sizing and Karthik (sales lead) for the discount/commit options. If the answers look straightforward we can propose 2-3 options by next week and outline the verification steps.

Next steps:
- Lara: send a short token forecast and confirm account model
- We'll produce a proposed pricing/options spreadsheet and a one-page MAP (mutual action plan)

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks — answers below:
- Peak token volume: the 3-5M tokens/mo estimate is per month for the first 3 months across all student projects combined (burst traffic expected during demo week). After month 4 we expect ~1M tokens/mo.
- Account model: student teams will initially publish under TeachForward-managed accounts (we want centralized billing), but we may migrate active startups to their own accounts later. For now, apply discounts to the TeachForward account and any sub-accounts owned by students under our billing profile.
- Procurement: we will need a standard MSLA + a PO. Procurement prefers a single PO for the pilot (covers first 6 months) and we need an invoice-able entity name and W-9.

I've attached the grant award letter and our 501c3 again.

Attachments: grant_award_letter.pdf (attached)

Lara Nguyen
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, MarkUs Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: TeachForward — pricing/eligibility request (proposal needed)

Folks — forwarding TeachForward request. Highlights:
- Verified 501c3, centralized billing desired, peak ~3-5M tokens/mo for first 3 months then ~1M/mo
- Procurement will require MSLA + PO for pilot (6 months)

What I'm proposing as starting options (to review):
Option A — Education pilot (no commit):
- 50% off list generation rate for verified education orgs for first 6 months
- Pilot cap: up to 10M tokens billed at discounted rate; overage at standard list
- Requires 501c3 + program description

Option B — Short-term commit (recommended for predictability):
- 6-month minimum commitment for $X of usage (credits) priced at 60% off list for the committed volume, with overage at 40% off list
- Includes 2x free onboarding hours + priority support for pilot period

Option C — Account-level exception (if finance approves):
- Temp baseline rate exception for TeachForward account: reduce baseline generation rate to $0.0025/token for first 6 months (subject to internal approval and DocuSign exception)

Attachments: proposed_pricing_options.xlsx (attached)

Vanessa

Vanessa / team — reviewed the background and attachments. TeachForward is a verified 501c3 and the projected volumes are modest. Finance is comfortable making a temporary exception to support the education program, with the following guardrails: 

Approved exception (finance sign-off):
- Apply a 60% discount to list generation rate for the TeachForward account for a 6-month pilot (effective from first invoice).
- Discount will apply up to 12M tokens across the pilot period. Any usage beyond that will be billed at 35% off list.
- We will require a signed rate-exception form (DocuSign) and a purchase order referencing deal HB-2026-0043.
- Provide a short MAP that includes verification artifacts (501c3), invoicing entity/W-9, and a contact for usage reviews at month 3.

I have attached the approved rate-exception template (docuSign_rate_exception.docx) and note: Marcus, please prepare the one-page MAP and Karthik, please prepare the draft commercial terms to include the PO language.

-Markus
